description: List the fields Muovi takes for one service, to read before calling `muovi_create_task_draft`. Pass a `service_slug` from `muovi_list_services`. Each slot has a `key`, the question in Spanish (`question_es`), a `type`, the accepted `options` for a choice, a `value_format` saying what to send, whether it is `required`, and an `ask_if` condition when it only applies after another answer. Collect every `required` slot, asking one question per message and waiting for the answer before asking the next. A draft whose `urgency` is `flexible` is complete without the date. The other slots are optional: do not ask them as a list; when what the person has told you, at any point in the conversation, gives an optional slot's value, send it in `slots` as well as writing it in `description`. Also ask what a professional would need to quote this specific job, skip anything the person already said, and write those details into the `description` of `muovi_create_task_draft`; no list of job questions is prescribed. Send the answers back keyed by slot `key` in the `slots` argument of `muovi_create_task_draft`. The person confirms the address on Muovi's map after opening the draft link. `photo_policy` says whether photos help; photos are added by the person on Muovi, not through this server. Read-only.
name: muovi_get_service_requirements
title: Get service requirements
